flow.name: 06 · State file persistence (Read/Write file)
flow.notes: Fires daily at noon. Reads a previously-saved timestamp from app-private storage, overwrites it with the current trigger time, then notifies showing both old and new values. Tests ReadFile with continueOnError (first run: file missing, var stays empty), WriteFile OVERWRITE, and state persistence across executions. To test sooner: in the editor, change the TimeOfDay trigger to 2 minutes from now and run it twice in a row.
